Thanks Jade — copying Finance and Vendor Ops. Quick checklist/questions so we can complete vendor master setup this week:

- Confirm legal entity matches W-9 (I see "Greenfield Inc" — good).
- Can you confirm the US bank routing + account numbers are for a USD ACH account (they typically want a scanned voided check or bank letter)?
- Do you have a preferred remit email for invoice delivery (PDF to invoice@ or EDI)?
- We require a Certificate of Insurance (COI) for vendor services > $50k; can you confirm if you can provide one or if you need Redwood's COI template?
- Please complete our procurement intake form so the vendor profile includes: tax address, payment remittance, ownership structure, backup withholding status. Link: https://procure.redwood.com/intake?vendor=greenfield (one-page).

If you can return the items below we can create the vendor record and issue a vendor code + first PO:
- signed W-9 (PDF)
- ACH worksheet with routing/account OR bank letter/voided check
- COI (if available)
- completed intake form

Adding a couple of Finance requirements:

- We need the remittance email for the invoice ingestion team (invoices@redwood.com is our default but vendors can specify a different address).
- For ACH, bank letter or voided check preferred; if not available we will accept the ACH form but it will trigger a verification hold until payment.
- Please confirm tax jurisdiction (state of formation) and whether there are any foreign entities. That affects tax withholding and reporting.
- COI: if Greenfield cannot provide COI by the time of vendor creation, we can still set up the vendor with "COI pending" but flagged; no payments > $50k will be released until cleared.

Also note: vendor onboarding to vendor master typically takes 2 business days once docs are complete; creating the vendor in the system will produce a vendor code (VND-XXXX) and a vendor profile link which I'll share.

Thanks — Laura
